APPROVE
The loop body's nested branches move into small helpers and the post-loop join becomes its own method, which plausibly brings `ParsePodfileLock` to 15 or below. The short-circuiting `||` keeps the original order of checks, so `entry` is only computed for PODS or DEPENDENCIES lines and is definitely assigned after the `continue`. I couldn't find the source file locally, so this assumes the unseen tail of the original method uses only `direct`, `resolved` and `lockPath`, and that its return type accepts a `List<CocoaPodDependency>`.
